materials_exhausted.note: All local sources relevant to the owner-layer blocker were reopened; remaining limitations are nonblocking cautions, not missing activity/database evidence.

summary: Source-reviewed rework recovered the Arminin 1a-C activity table, reconciled the linked DBAASP records, and converted the prior framework-test stop into a caution-bearing publication-grade final review.
adjudication_summary: Arminin 1a-C has source-supported Table 2 IC50 rows for five leukemia and three normal human cell targets, a source-supported human-erythrocyte hemolysis observation, and membrane-disruption mechanism evidence. The only retained database conflict is the linked hemolysis-row unit mismatch, so the paper is accepted_with_cautions rather than accepted_clean.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP IC50 rows for Table 2 targets are source_verified against primary XML Table 2 and PDF text; duplicated assay/experiment rows are retained with matched activity IDs. The hemolysis linked row is preserved as source_conflict because the database unit differs from the primary paper unit.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 repaired the unsupported matrix parse by manually mapping Table 2 headers to eight source-supported IC50 rows and adding the source-supported hemolysis observation from results text/Figure 3.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism output was corrected to membrane permeabilization, SEM pore/morphology evidence, FITC binding, and CD structure support; previous generic automated mechanism-context labels were removed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_6_final_review: The prior full_source_review_not_completed ticket is resolved; final review remains accepted_with_cautions because the hemolysis database unit conflict is deliberately preserved.

caution_findings.evidence_context: linked DBAASP hemolysis rows record concentration 300 µg/ml, while primary paper text and Figure 3 support 300 µM for 15% hemolysis.
linked_assay_records.jsonl and linked_experiment_records.jsonl duplicate the same nine DBAASP assay rows; both copies are retained with matched primary locators.
local supplementary surfaces were checked; they provide HPLC/MS/P-gp figures and article HTML/PDF surfaces, not additional source-supported activity table values.
